subject: Insurance
title: Dead Peasant Insurance
description: A short lesson to help you apply Dead Peasant Insurance.

hook.text: Walmart secretly insured 350,000 employees and collected death benefits when they died.

buildup.text: Corporate-owned life insurance—nicknamed 'dead peasant' policies—let companies profit from workers' deaths.

discovery.text: Companies argued it covered the cost of replacing employees.

twist.text: Tax loopholes made COLI profitable. Companies deducted premiums and collected tax-free death benefits.

climax.text: Congress tightened rules in 2006, requiring employee consent. But the practice still exists in a limited, legal form.

punchline.text: Your employer profits when you die. Dead peasant insurance is legal.

quiz.question: What is 'dead peasant' insurance?
options: Policies companies buy on employees' lives, keeping the payout
